show.synopsis: Two struggling musicians, Joe and Jerry, witness a mob murder and must go on the run. Disguising themselves as women, they join an all-female band and end up entangled in a hilarious web of mistaken identities, high-stakes hijinks, and unexpected romance. Packed with big laughs, dazzling dance numbers, and an irresistible score, "Some Like It Hot" is a wildly entertaining musical adaptation of the classic comedy film.

show.synopsis: "Parade" tells the gripping true story of the 1913 trial of Leo Frank, a Jewish factory manager accused of murdering a young girl in Atlanta. As the trial unfolds, the community's antisemitism and political tensions threaten to tear the city apart. With soaring melodies and a powerful narrative, this Tony-winning musical explores the pursuit of justice and the human cost of prejudice in early 20th-century America.
